name: Monkey Fish
text:
**Monkey Fish**

**School** transmutation; **Level** alchemist 1, arcanist 1, druid 1, hunter 1, investigator 1, magus 1, psychic 1, redmantisassassin 1, shaman 1, sorcerer 1, wizard 1
**Casting Time** 1 standard action
**Components** V, S
**Range** personal
**Target** you
**Duration** 1 minute/level (D)
**Saving Throw** none; **Spell Resistance** no

Your hands and feet alter to make you better at climbing and swimming. You gain a 10 foot climb speed and swim speed. This spell has no effect if you are wearing medium or heavy armor or carrying a medium or heavy load.
